admins.title: Administrator User Guide
admins.description: Administrators are responsible for managing the platform settings, approving staff roles, provisioning accounts, and controlling when final voting results are made public.

developers.title: Developer Reference Guide
developers.description: This document provides a technical overview of the VOTABLE PORTAL Portfolio Voting System codebase, database schema, security rules, and testing standards.

intro.title: System Overview
intro.description: Welcome to the VOTABLE PORTAL Academy Portfolio Voting System user documentation!

staff.title: Staff User Guide
staff.description: Staff members of VOTABLE PORTAL Academy act as monitors of the portfolio voting process. This is a read-only role designed to oversee activity without interfering with candidate uploads or ballot submissions.

students.title: Student User Guide
students.description: As a Student of VOTABLE PORTAL Academy, you have the opportunity to showcase your portfolio project to your peers and cast your vote in the portfolio competition.
